EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
My Ref No.: DS/IMA/L3/2/27.
I, hereby give notice, under Sub-section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the government intends to acquire the following land which is required for a public purpose.

Description of the Land to be acquired: One allotment of land in total extent of 0.5972 Hectare depicted as Lot No. 1453 in FVP No. 652 Suppliment 49 and dated 12.01.2015 prepared by the Surveyor General Situated in Angulugaha Village in the Imaduwa Divisional Secretary Division in the District of Galle in Southern Province morefully described as follows Lot No. 1453.

Name of the Land: Thoragodavila, Maththe Udumulla, Wellekumbura, Odekumbura, Kalaeliya-kumbura; Land Detail: Open Barren Land; Original Claimed by: Karagoda Gamage Thilakarathne; Extent: 0.5972 Hectare.
North: Lot No. 268; East: Lot No. 268 and 257; South: Lot No. 268; West: Lot No. 268.
All persons interested in the aforesaid Land are hereby required to appear personally or by agents duly authorized in writing before me at Imaduwa Divisional

Secretariat on the 23rd March, 2015 at 10.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (In duplicate) on or before the 16th March, 2015 the nature of their interests in the Land the Particulars or their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said Land the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
G. G. LAKSHMI KANTHI, Divisional Secretary, Imaduwa. Divisional Secretary, Imaduwa. 25th February, 2015. 03 - 464

THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7

I, hereby give notice, under Sub section (i) of section 7 of the land acquisition Act, as Amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude which is required for a public purpose.
Description of the Land or servitude to be acquired: Allotments of lands in total extent of about 2.1967 Hectares depicted in the Advance tracing No. VA/

VAV/2014/141 dated 15th July, 2014 prepared by the Surveyor General, situated in the village called Sastirikulankulam Grama Niladhari Division Sastirikulan-kulam of Divisional Secretary’s Division Vavuniya of Vavuniya District in Northern Province and described in below names, extents and boundaries as follows:
Lot No. A 1671 — Name of the Land: Periya-kulamkadu; Name and address of the Claimant: Ms. Sivagnanam Kamalam, No. 2/A, Mannar Road, Kurumankadu, Vavuniya; Extent: 0.3982 Hectare.
Boundary: North: Lot 1675; East: Lot 1675 (Foot Path); South: Lot 1672; West: Lot 1675.

All persons interested in the aforesaid land* on which servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Conference Hall of Vavuniya Divisional Secretariat on the 09th day of April, 2015 at 9.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (induplicate) on or before the 02nd April, 2015 of the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land/servitude the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
K. UTHAYARAJAH, Divisional Secretary, Vavuniya. Divisional Secretary’s Office, Vavuniya. 24th February, 2015. 03 - 466/1
